__comment: The tool rack (doc 294, concept B, the pegged board): the Carpenter's first piece and the first storage furniture. Half a split log, its round back to the wall and its split face out, lashed to two wall pegs, with three stout pegs driven in. Tier 1 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs.

Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench from one log; it keeps its wood. It hangs on a wall over the three floor cells its tools hang into, so dwarves walk round it (floor_wall: a wall behind every cell).

storage (ContainerStorageComponent): it holds tools (the tool tag), one on each of its three hooks, starting at priority 4, ahead of ground storage. The anchors are the hooks, in footprint-local blocks from the back-left floor corner; hang hangs each tool upright from its top.
description: Half a split log pegged against a wall, with three stout pegs to hang tools on. It keeps three of the colony's tools where everyone can see them.
